claim: A Duke wall wearing door art (CheckDoorTile, e.g. DOORTILE23) with a lotag is a Use control like a switch: using it operates the activators and master switches on that lotag and plays its hitag as a sound. A converter that treats only switch tiles as controls loses these senders, leaving their receivers with nothing to start them.
evidence: reference/eduke32/source/duke3d/src/sector.cpp:1351-1353 and 1519-1521 (a door tile passes P_ActivateSwitch; G_OperateMasterSwitches(lotag))
E4L1 wall 2318 (lotag 8000, hitag 327): its three charges and three falling sectors were converted on two channels with no sender
use: List tagged door-art walls as controls when converting (conversion_coverage reports them as tagged_use_wall) and wire them by hand until the converter lowers them.
